name: reforged-ts-probe
description: The Probe runner of the reforged-ts workspace: builds a Probe, a TypeScript file that runs in the real game, into a map folder, and reads the Result file it writes. Node programs behind the root probe:* scripts, and the reader module the package's other scripts import. Never published.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p test/tsconfig.json && tsc -p probes/tsconfig.json && tsc -p test/lua/tsconfig.json --noEmit
